title: Data in Orchard Core: Databases, YesSql and Documents | Orchard Core
description:
Orchard Core keeps its content items, users, settings and workflows in a relational database, and every site chooses and configures that database.

This video explains how YesSql stores documents and indexes, how a session saves and queries them, how a tenant selects its database provider on the Setup screen, which options control SQLite, YesSql and the table names, and how to run your own SQL against the tenant's database.

In this video:
• Documents and indexes: how YesSql stores your data
• The session: saving and querying documents
• Choosing a database: providers and the Setup screen
• SQLite: the database file and connection pooling
• YesSql options: page size, isolation level and telemetry
• Table names: presets for the tables of a tenant
• Running SQL: connections, quoted names and transactions
